title: CLCON/95/2017 of Manoj Sharma Vs N. S. Napalchyal

paras.text:
CLCON No. 95 of 2017
U.C. Dhyani, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Dy. Advocate General
for the respondent / contemnor.
Learned Dy. Advocate General
submitted that order dated 20.01.2017, passed
by Hon'ble Vacation Judge in WPCRL no.
102 of 2017 (copy Annexure-1 to the petition)
has been complied with.
Compliance affidavit has been filed on
12.05.2017, in which the Senior
Superintendent of Police has, in para 10 of the
affidavit, submitted that the order in so far as
the same relates to the answering respondent
has been duly complied with in letter and
spirit and, therefore, contempt proceedings
initiated against the answering respondent
may kindly be dropped.
Since the order sought to be executed
has been complied with by the Senior
Superintendent of police, Tehri Garhwal,
therefore, present contempt petition is closed.
Notice issued to the respondent is
discharged.
(Urgency application no. 5341 of 2017
stands disposed of).
